comparisons.peer_topic: Scope of patent litigation and revenue impact
comparisons.peer_summary: The pending and past lawsuits pertain to substantially all of Micron's DRAM, NAND, and other memory and storage products, which account for substantially all of the company's revenue.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Micron explicitly disclose that their NAND memory products constitute a significant, if not the primary, portion of their revenue streams, highlighting the strategic and financial centrality of this specific technology segment. While Intel discusses the divestiture of its NAND business as a discrete financial event involving a remaining receivable, Micron discloses that its NAND products are integral to its overall revenue and are the subject of extensive patent litigation, underscoring the high value and risk associated with this specific asset class for memory-focused peers.

sentences.text: We sold our NAND memory technology and manufacturing business (the NAND OpCo Business) to SK hynix Inc. (SK hynix), which we deconsolidated upon closing the first phase of the transaction on December 29, 2021.
The above lawsuits pertain to substantially all of our DRAM, NAND, and other memory and storage products we manufacture, which account for substantially all of our revenue.
